name: mcpscraper-sdk-monorepo
description: Public client SDKs and API contracts for mcpscraper.dev and memory.mcpscraper.dev

scripts.test:contract-projection: node --test --import tsx tests/mcp-contract-telemetry.test.ts tests/update-mcp-manifest.test.ts tests/update-memory-manifest.test.ts tests/gmail-contract.test.ts tests/xray-journey-contract.test.ts tests/personal-assistant-contract.test.ts
scripts.test:python: node scripts/run-python-project.mjs packages/scraper-python -m pytest packages/scraper-python/tests && node scripts/run-python-project.mjs packages/memory-python -m pytest packages/memory-python/tests
scripts.generate:mcp: node --import tsx scripts/generate-mcp-client.ts && node scripts/run-python-project.mjs packages/scraper-python scripts/generate-mcp-python.py
scripts.verify:parity: npm run build --workspace=mcpscraper-memory-sdk && node --import tsx scripts/verify-sdk-parity.ts && node scripts/run-python-project.mjs packages/scraper-python scripts/verify_sdk_parity.py
